questions.question_text: Masonry orders its children by row. Which component should I use instead to order images by column, and what determines the container heights there?
questions.reference_answer: Use an ImageList configured as a masonry image list to order images by column. Its container heights are dynamically sized to reflect the aspect ratio of each image.
questions.naive_answer: For ordering images by column in Material-UI, you should use the `Grid` component. The container heights are determined by the `auto` or `fill` properties of the `Grid` item or the `Grid` itself.
questions.bm25_rag_answer: To order images by column, you should use [ImageList](/material-ui/react-image-list/#masonry-image-list) [2]. The container heights in this case are determined by the images' dimensions, as `Masonry` orders its children by row by default. To change this behavior, you need to use [ImageList](/material-ui/react-image-list/#masonry-image-list) which orders images by column.
